report.summary: Unit 1303 is flagged with a high failure risk of 10.2%, at or above the 5% false-alarm rate threshold. Sensor S060 contributes most to the model's risk score, with a SHAP value of 0.803 log-odds, and its sensor-health check reports status ok. Sensors S200, S336 and S472 are on watch status with out-of-reference rates of 12.9%, 13.9% and 10.7%, and they are the largest contributors to the SPE and T² statistics for this unit. The EWMA alarm is active across the 19 units in the FDC window, while the T² and SPE values stay below their control limits and the FDC alarm level is none.

limitations: The evidence shows statistical associations only; it cannot establish that any sensor or process condition causes the failure risk.
SHAP values describe the model's risk score in log-odds and the T² and SPE contributions describe the control chart, not the physical process.
16 sensor readings are missing for Unit 1303, so the risk score and contributions rest on incomplete input.
